name: Honoring Leaders
overview: Scripture calls believers to honor and submit to their leaders, recognizing that all authority is established by God (Romans 13:1). This respect extends from the family to governing authorities and spiritual overseers, as seen in the command to honor parents for a blessed life (Exodus 20:12) and to obey those who guide in the word of God (Hebrews 13:7,17). Such honor is marked by humility and esteeming others above oneself (Philippians 2:3), fostering unity and joy in leadership relationships.
